language.name: English
app.name: Next Rating
app.tagline: Predicts your next PDGA rating update from your rated rounds, including new rounds with unofficial round ratings and ratings you add yourself.
app.unofficial: Unofficial tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by the PDGA (Professional Disc Golf Association).
app.privacy: Your data stays in this browser. Nothing is sent to any server.
tabs.label: Views
start.title: Get started
start.stepInstall: Install the bookmarklet, a bookmark that brings your rounds here from pdga.com.
start.stepOpen: Open your ratings details on pdga.com and run the bookmarklet there.
start.stepOpenPlayer: Open the ratings details of {player} on pdga.com and run the bookmarklet there.
start.stepPaste: Or copy the ratings table on pdga.com and paste it here.
start.noData: No data for this player yet.

import.title: Import
import.status.partial: Some pages could not be read. Everything else was imported.
import.status.challenge: pdga.com asked for a browser check, so the import stopped early. What was read before that was imported.
import.status.unsupported-page: The bookmarklet works on a PDGA player page, ratings details page or event results page. Open one of those and run it again.
import.status.error: The bookmarklet could not read this page. Reload the page on pdga.com and try again.
import.error.too-large: The import is too large to read.
import.error.malformed: The import could not be read. Run the bookmarklet again.
import.error.version: This import comes from a different version of the bookmarklet. Reload this page, and update the bookmarklet if it happens again.
import.error.unsupported: This browser cannot read imports. Update it, or paste the table on the Import tab instead.
import.failed.one: Open this page and run the bookmarklet there:
import.failed.other: Open these pages and run the bookmarklet on each of them:
import.outdated: A newer version of the bookmarklet is available. Install it again to get it.
import.noPlayer: Event results need a player to read rounds for. Enter your PDGA number, then run the bookmarklet on the event page again.
import.storageFull: This import could not be saved in this browser, so it is kept only until you close the page. If storage is full, remove players you no longer follow.

paste.help: On a computer, open the ratings details or an event's results on pdga.com, select the whole page (Ctrl+A, or Cmd+A on a Mac), copy it and paste it here.
paste.touchHint: Pasting from a phone browser doesn't work, because the table headers can't be selected there. On a phone, use the bookmarklet.

setup.title: Install the bookmarklet
setup.intro: The bookmarklet is a bookmark that reads your rounds on pdga.com and brings them here. Install it once in each browser you use.
setup.reads: It only reads the page you run it on and a few related pdga.com pages, never cookies, passwords or form fields.
setup.copied: Copied. Now follow the steps for your browser.
setup.stepCopy: Copy the bookmarklet with the button above.
setup.iphone.title: Safari on iPhone
setup.iphone.bookmark: Tap Share, then Add Bookmark, and save it as Next Rating.
setup.iphone.edit: Open Bookmarks, tap Edit, tap Next Rating, and replace its address with the copied code.
setup.iphone.run: On a pdga.com player or event page, open Bookmarks and tap Next Rating.
setup.android.title: Chrome on Android
setup.android.bookmark: Tap ⋮, then the star, to bookmark this page.
setup.android.edit: Edit the bookmark: name it Next Rating and replace its URL with the copied code.
setup.android.run: On a pdga.com player or event page, type Next Rating in the address bar and tap the bookmark among the suggestions.
setup.desktop.title: Desktop browsers
setup.desktop.bookmark: Create a new bookmark (Ctrl+D, or Cmd+D on a Mac), name it Next Rating and paste the code as its URL.
setup.desktop.run: On a pdga.com player or event page, click the bookmark.
